name: @ytview/desktop
description: YouTube Picture-in-Picture desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
author: YTView contributors

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node ../../scripts/copy-file.cjs src/preload/preload.cjs dist-electron/preload/preload.cjs && node ../../scripts/copy-file.cjs electron-loader.cjs dist-electron/electron-loader.cjs
scripts.electron:build: node ../../scripts/prepare-win-codesign.cjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: node ../../scripts/prepare-win-codesign.cjs && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.test: tsc src/main/queue-logic.ts --outDir dist-test --module es2020 --target es2020 --skipLibCheck && node --test test/
